{{Top|leg}}
A '''crater plain''' was a type of landform on the [[Rishi moon|moon]] of [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]], which housed a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Rishi Station/Legends|outpost]]. Crater plains and rocky terrain dominated the moon's surface.
